summary: American action star Steven Seagal built a career on invented exploits and mob money, faced decades of sexual assault and trafficking allegations, played reserve sheriff's deputy on reality TV, and befriended dictators until Russia made him an envoy in 2018.

marriage and aikido years in Osaka, Japan, reportedly to dodge the draft
staged demo and Ovitz backing lead to Above the Law (1988), his first film
Nasso partnership and Gambino family ties behind his early films
alleged attempt to hire a hit on former collaborator Gary Goldman
rape allegation by an extra from the On Deadly Ground shoot
recognised as a reincarnated lama; bribery accusations from other Buddhists
reserve deputy claims with Jefferson Parish and the Lawman reality show
2010 lawsuit alleging assistant was held and assaulted at his Louisiana home
2011 Maricopa County raid with an armored vehicle; roosters and a puppy killed
Russian citizenship in 2016 and appointment as special envoy in 2018
